components.purpose: Page intro banner (heading + optional subheading/description) — e.g. 'Contact Us', setting context before the form and details below.

Covers the rest of the request in one component — it has a built-in contact form (heading, description, submit URL, success/error messages) plus dedicated 'Office Address', 'Phone Number', and 'Email Address' fields, so it delivers the form, office address, phone number, and email all in a single, purpose-built block.
